notes:
A health metric indicating the percentage of total body weight composed of fat. Widely discussed in Japanese health media and everyday conversation about fitness. Many Japanese bathroom scales (⟦{体組成計|たいそせいけい}→体組成計：29137_taisoseikei⟧) measure this automatically.
